data.name: Isabella
data.gender_notes: Isabella is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God is my oath; devoted to God
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Elisheva, 'God is my oath', via the Spanish Isabel. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-sh-b-ʿ. Elizabeth, mother of John the Baptist (Luke 1). Isabella is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my oath; devoted to God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Isabella expresses “God is my oath; devoted to God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Elisheva, 'God is my oath', via the Spanish Isabel.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isabella total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
